summary: Iteration 26 - Profile & Account Management Feature Testing. Comprehensive backend (19/20 passed, 1 skipped) and frontend testing of profile GET/PUT, change password, forgot/reset password OTP flow, account summary, export data, and soft delete. All 7 profile sections verified on desktop. Mobile testing limited due to auth state not persisting across page navigation (known limitation).

BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile updates display_name successfully
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile validates phone format (rejects invalid)
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile validates timezone (rejects invalid)
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile validates capital > 0 (rejects 0 or negative)
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile updates preferred_instruments
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/account/profile updates notification_preferences
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/profile/change-password with wrong current password returns 400
BACKEND: PUT /api/v1/profile/change-password with correct password changes it, can login with new password
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password returns 200 regardless of email existence (no leak)
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password with wrong OTP returns 400
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password with correct OTP resets password successfully
BACKEND: GET /api/v1/account/summary returns account_mode, strategy counts, member_since
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/export-data returns JSON with strategies, paper_trades, performance_records

BACKEND: Subsequent login after soft-delete blocked with 'Account deactivated'
FRONTEND: Profile page loads with all 7 sections (personal, password, preferences, notifications, account, integrations, app)

FRONTEND: Preferences section has timezone dropdown, default capital input, instruments input

FRONTEND: App section shows Restart Tour button, App Version v1.3.0, Report Bug link

FRONTEND: Sidebar profile link shows avatar initial and email, navigates to /profile

skipped_tests: BACKEND: test_reset_password_reused_otp - OTP not found in logs (timing issue)
critical_code_review_comments: Profile API correctly validates phone format, timezone list, and capital > 0
OTP-based password reset flow works correctly with 15-minute expiry
OTP is logged to backend stdout when EMAIL_ENABLED=false (for testing)
Soft delete sets is_active=false and blocks subsequent login with clear message
Integration cards correctly show 'Coming Soon' badges with cursor-not-allowed and opacity-60
useApi del() function correctly accepts config object for passing data in DELETE requests
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during pytest run (otp_test_*, delete_test_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 tested the new Profile & Account Management features. All backend APIs work correctly: profile GET/PUT with validation, change password, forgot/reset password OTP flow, account summary, export data, and soft delete. Frontend profile page has all 7 sections working. Known limitation: auth state stored in React state (not localStorage), so direct URL navigation loses auth. Mobile testing of profile page requires client-side navigation (clicking links) rather than direct URL access. OTP is logged to /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log when EMAIL_ENABLED=false.

profile_features_verified: Personal Info: display_name, email (read-only), phone, member_since
Password: change password with current/new/confirm validation
Preferences: timezone dropdown (15 options), default capital, preferred instruments
Notifications: 3 toggle switches for email preferences
Account: mode switch, stats display, export data, delete account with confirmation
Integrations: Zerodha/Angel One/Upstox placeholders with Coming Soon badges
App: Restart Tour, App Version v1.3.0, Report Bug mailto link
otp_flow_verified: Forgot password returns 200 regardless of email existence (prevents email enumeration)
OTP is 6 digits, expires in 15 minutes
OTP logged to backend stdout when EMAIL_ENABLED=false
Reset password validates OTP and password strength
Used OTP marked as used (cannot be reused)
known_limitations: Auth state stored in React state, not localStorage - direct URL navigation loses auth
Mobile profile navigation requires client-side link clicks, not direct URL access
